features.text: GetInfo: Retrieve information about document pages: size, height, width etc. (POST /merger/info)
Join: Join multiple documents into one document (POST /merger/join)
Mix: Join selected pages from multiple documents into one document (POST /merger/mix)
Split: Split single document to multiple documents (POST /merger/split)
Import: Import attachments into pdf document (POST /merger/import)
Extract: Make new document with some pages from source document (POST /merger/pages/extract)
Orientation: Make new document and apply new orientation mode for specified pages (POST /merger/pages/orientation)
Swap: Swap two pages within document (POST /merger/pages/swap)
CheckPassword: Checks whether document is password protected (GET /merger/password)
